about: Model verdicts on source against tree for decent-home-2006 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Paragraphs 4.1 to 4.4 are merged into one unnumbered text block and their numbers sit alone in a separate note, so no provision can be found by its number.
findings.evidence: source: "4.2 Dwellings which fail to meet this criterion are those containing one or more hazards" / tree: note "4.1 4.2 4.3 4.4"

findings.problem: The chapter title and the heading "Introduction" are read as body text, and the chapter title is left as only "SECTION 4".
findings.evidence: source: "A decent home – summary of the definition" and "Introduction" / tree: "A decent home – summary of the definition Introduction The definition of what is a decent home"

findings.problem: The criterion headings a), b) and c) are run into the paragraph text instead of standing as headings between the paragraphs.
findings.evidence: tree: "four criteria: a) It meets the current statutory minimum standard for housing Dwellings which fail to meet this criterion"

findings.problem: Footnote 1 is kept as ordinary section text, not as a footnote tied to its marker, and the marker is glued to the word.
findings.evidence: source: "guidance on HHSRS¹" / tree: "statutory guidance on HHSRS1" and text "1 Housing Act 2004, Part 1. Statutory Guidance has been given"

findings.problem: The page number is kept at the end of the footnote text.
findings.evidence: tree: "www.communities.gov.uk/hhsrs 11"

findings.problem: Two words in the footnote are run together.
findings.evidence: source: "the HHSRS Operating Guidance" / tree: "the HHSRSOperating Guidance"

findings.problem: The heading "Building components" is read as the end of paragraph 5.7 and is not in the heading path of paragraphs 5.8 to 5.11.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Building components" / tree: "A component cannot fail this criterion based on age alone. Building components"

findings.problem: The heading "Old and in poor condition" is read as the end of paragraph 5.11 and is not in the heading path of paragraph 5.12.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Old and in poor condition" / tree: "need replacing or require immediate major repair. Old and in poor condition"

findings.problem: Paragraphs 6.1 to 6.5 are merged into one unnumbered text block and their numbers sit alone in separate notes, so no provision can be found by its number.
findings.evidence: source: "6.4 When considering refurbishment packages, landlords should consult with current Building Regulations" / tree: notes "6.1" and "6.2 6.3 6.4 6.5"

findings.problem: The chapter title and the heading "Standard of work to be carried out" are read as body text, and the chapter title is left as only "SECTION 6".
findings.evidence: tree: "Implementing the Decent Homes standard – Social sector This section explains" and "most effective long-term strategy. Standard of work to be carried out The Decent Homes standard"

findings.problem: Footnotes 10 and 11 are kept as ordinary section text, not as footnotes tied to their markers, and the markers are glued to the words.
findings.evidence: source: "technical publications.¹⁰" and "Green Street¹¹" / tree: "publications.10 And the current", "Green Street11", "10 www.communities.gov.uk/buildingregs 11 www.greenstreet.org.uk"

findings.problem: The page number is kept as a note of its own.
findings.evidence: tree: note "20"

findings.problem: Paragraphs 7.5 to 7.9 are merged into one paragraph numbered "1", and their numbers are split off into two separate notes.
findings.evidence: source: "7.5 Local monitoring requires the establishment of local baselines" / tree: number "1" "Local monitoring requires..."; notes "7.5" and "7.6 7.7 7.8 7.9"

findings.problem: The heading "Predicting future progress" is read as body text inside the merged paragraph and is missing from the heading path.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Predicting future progress" / tree: "renegotiated deadline. Predicting future progress The following paragraphs explain"

findings.problem: Footnote 16 is kept as plain section text, not as a note tied to its marker in paragraph 7.6, and the page number is joined to it.
findings.evidence: tree: "16 Decent Homes: Capturing the standard at the local level, DTLR (ODPM) (March 2002) ... www.communities.gov.uk/decenthomes 27"

findings.problem: The Annex A heading and its paragraph 1 are merged into the body of paragraph 7.36 of Section 7, so the annex is not a section of its own.
findings.evidence: source: heading "ANNEX A" then "1. Table 1 shows the component lifetimes" / tree: para 7.36 "...DCLG web site18. ANNEX A Component lifetimes and definition ... 1. Table 1 shows"

findings.problem: Table 1 sits under the wrong parent in the heading path: Section 7 instead of Annex A.
findings.evidence: tree: "SECTION 7 > Predicting impact of investment > Table 1 Component lifetimes used in the disrepair criterion"

findings.problem: The three bullet conditions that end Annex A paragraph 3 are not in the paragraph but in the text of Table 2, so the paragraph stops at "unless:" and runs into Annex B.
findings.evidence: source: "rather than replacement unless: the component is sufficiently damaged that it is impossible to repair;" / tree: "rather than replacement unless: ANNEX B Clarifying the Roles"

findings.problem: Annex A paragraphs 2 and 3 and the heading "In poor condition" are merged into the body of paragraph 7.36 of Section 7.
findings.evidence: source: heading "In poor condition" then "2. Table 2 sets out the definitions" / tree: para 7.36 "...function effectively. In poor condition 2. Table 2 sets out"

findings.problem: Table 2 sits under the wrong parent in the heading path: Section 7 instead of Annex A.
findings.evidence: tree: "SECTION 7 > Predicting impact of investment > Table 2 Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in disrepair criterion"
